intro: Jobs similar to film and video editors are media, design and production roles. By O*NET 31.0 data, the closest are special effects artists and animators (80% similar), Graphic Designers (78%) and Producers and Directors (77%).
shared: These careers share long hours in editing or design software, shaping a story frame by frame and meeting release deadlines. O*NET rates complex problem solving at 3.25 out of 5 for editors, and judgment and time management at 3.12. Animation, art direction and broadcast work use the same skills. 7 of the 20 pay more than the $75,420 editor median.

faq.q: Which jobs like video editor pay more?
faq.a: 7 of the 20 similar careers pay more. Art Directors earn $114,850 (52% more), special effects artists and animators $102,030 (35% more) and Producers and Directors $90,360 (20% more), according to BLS May 2025 data, with no more preparation than editing.

faq.q: Is graphic design similar to video editing?
faq.a: Yes. Graphic Designers are 78% similar to film and video editors and use much of the same software. They earn $62,960, which is 17% less, according to BLS May 2025 data. Desktop Publishers are 73% similar and need less preparation.
